name: Accordion threshold review
idea: A rapid model-review habitat that opens and closes a sequence of private viewing bays around one shared review table, derived from a fan-folded canopy and rounded vaults rather than a pod archetype.
shape_ancestry: one continuous pleated ribbon becomes a row of three inflated vaulted bays, with each fold sharing one rounded spine and one cantilevered viewing cavity
silhouette: a low horizontal fan of three unequal rounded vaults rises from a single curved spine, ending in one open crescent bay that remains legible when reduced
exaggeration: stretch the final crescent bay far beyond the two rear vaults so the opening becomes the memorable spatial event
aperture_rule: use one deep crescent threshold at the enlarged bay and two smaller rounded sight openings along the folded spine; no rectangular windows or black display bands
construction_cues: one continuous warm-metal spine explains the folding sequence
one circular review table is nested under the enlarged crescent bay
three upholstered ledges follow the fan's shared curvature
material_direction: soft sage enamel ribbon, warm ivory molded shell, blush translucent resin apertures, muted amber trim, cream upholstery, and diffuse world-fair model lighting
